title: Disabled fire survivor told to leave Kīhei FEMA housing
summary: On August 13, a commissioner said they are working to find one man housing in Kīhei that is not tied to FEMA. Aging office staff said he became disabled while in FEMA housing there and was told to move back to Lahaina, away from his services, and they sent his case to the mayor's office as an Office of Recovery issue. Staff said many have set up routines and services where they now live.
